title: Sex hormone blood test
what: A regular blood test from a vein. It checks the hormones that control the menstrual cycle, pregnancy, and men's health.
why: For cycle problems, planning a pregnancy, infertility, erection problems, acne, or too much body hair.
duration: drawing the blood takes a few minutes
tell_doctor: Which day of your cycle it is today
If you take hormone pills, birth control, or other hormones
If you are pregnant or breastfeeding
All medicines and supplements you take regularly

prepare.title: Cycle day
prepare.text: For women, many hormones are tested on certain days of the cycle. Often days 2 to 5, and progesterone about a week before your period. Your doctor will tell you the exact day.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: Usually in the morning, best on an empty stomach: after dinner, only water. For men, testosterone is usually tested before 11 a.m.

prepare.title: The day before
prepare.text: For 24 hours, avoid exercise, alcohol, and sex. They can change the result.

prepare.title: Before the test
prepare.text: Do not smoke for at least 1 hour. Sit quietly for 10 to 15 minutes. Stress affects prolactin.

bring: Your referral with the list of hormones
The date your last period started
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on a support
A band is tightened above your elbow
The skin is wiped with alcohol and blood is taken from a vein into tubes
The puncture spot is pressed with cotton or covered with a bandage
feel: A quick prick and light pressure from the band
If you feel faint at the sight of blood, say so first. You can lie down
after: Keep the cotton pressed for a few minutes to avoid a bruise
You can eat and go back to your day right away
Only your doctor should judge the result. Normal levels depend on your cycle day and age

faq.q: On which day of my cycle should I test hormones?
faq.a: Most often on days 2 to 5, and progesterone about a week before your period. But your doctor chooses the day for your situation.

faq.q: Can I test hormones during my period?
faq.a: Yes. Many hormones are tested in the first days of the cycle, while you still have your period.

reminders.text: Hormone test tomorrow. Today, no exercise, alcohol, or sex. In the morning, empty stomach, only water.
